अभिकथन (A): विदेशी सेवा के दौरान आहरित वेतन को मूल विभाग में पेंशन की गणना में शामिल नहीं किया जाता।
कारण (R): पेंशन की गणना मूल संवर्ग में उस काल्पनिक वेतन के आधार पर की जाती है जिसे कर्मचारी वहाँ आहरित करता, जिसके लिए पेंशन अंशदान दिया जाता है।

A और R दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं है

questions.question_english: Consider the following Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Assertion (A): Pay drawn during foreign service is not taken into account for calculation of pension in the parent department. Reason (R): Pension is strictly calculated based on the notional pay the employee would have drawn in the parent cadre, against which pension contributions are paid.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: While on foreign service, pay drawn from the foreign employer is not considered for pension calculations in the parent department. Pension is calculated on the notional basic pay the employee would have drawn in their parent cadre, against which required pension contributions are paid to the government account
questions.explanation_hindi: विदेश सेवा में पेंशन की गणना मूल संवर्ग के नियमों और पेंशन अंशदान की व्यवस्था के अनुसार होती है। स्रोत के अनुसार विदेशी सेवा में आहरित वेतन के बजाय मूल विभाग में लागू काल्पनिक वेतन को आधार माना जाता है।
key_facts: Answer key: (A)

पिछले दस महीनों में मिले औसत मासिक वेतन के आधार पर

questions.question_english: Which statements below about ‘Leave Salary’ during Earned Leave is correct?
options_english: It is calculated as half of the basic pay along with full applicable dearness allowance
It is calculated based on the average monthly pay drawn during the last ten months
It equals the pay drawn immediately before proceeding on leave
It is based strictly on basic pay alone and excludes all allowances including HRA
questions.explanation_english: Under the Central Civil Services Leave Rules 1972, leave salary during Earned Leave is equal to the pay drawn by the government servant immediately before proceeding on leave. The employee continues to draw full basic pay along with applicable allowances like Dearness Allowance and House Rent Allowance during leave
questions.explanation_hindi: अर्जित अवकाश पर अवकाश वेतन सामान्यतः अवकाश पर जाने से ठीक पहले आहरित वेतन के आधार पर निर्धारित होता है। इसमें लागू नियमों के अनुसार वेतन के अनुमन्य घटक शामिल होते हैं।
key_facts: Answer key: (C)

options_hindi: संचयी प्रभाव के बिना एक वर्ष के लिए वेतनवृद्धि रोकी जाती है
संचयी प्रभाव के साथ एक वर्ष के लिए वेतनवृद्धि रोकी जाती है

questions.question_english: What is the impact of a minor penalty of “censure” on the annual increment of a government servant?
options_english: Annual increment is stopped for one year without cumulative financial effect
Annual increment is stopped for one year with cumulative financial effect
The employee is demoted by one cell in the pay matrix of the current level
It has no direct impact on drawing the annual increment
questions.explanation_english: Censure is a formal minor penalty representing severe administrative disapproval. Unlike penalties like withholding of increment, censure does not carry any financial penalty or direct stoppage of pay. Therefore, imposing censure has no direct impact on the drawing of regular annual increments by the government servant
questions.explanation_hindi: निंदा (censure) एक मामूली दंड है, लेकिन स्रोत के अनुसार इससे वार्षिक वेतनवृद्धि अपने-आप नहीं रुकती। वेतनवृद्धि रोकने के लिए अलग से ऐसा दंडादेश आवश्यक है।

options_hindi: A और R दोनों सत्य हैं तथा R, A की सही व्याख्या है

questions.question_english: Consider the following Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Assertion (A): House Rent Allowance (HRA) is admissible to a government servant even if they refuse government accommodation allotted to them. Reason (R): The purpose of HRA is to provide financial assistance for housing, which becomes inadmissible if an employee refuses the housing facility provided by the government.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: House Rent Allowance is meant to compensate employees for housing expenses. If a government servant refuses government accommodation allotted to them under general pool housing rules, they forfeit eligibility to draw House Rent Allowance. The assertion stating HRA is admissible upon refusal is incorrect, while the reason is correct
questions.explanation_hindi: स्रोत सामग्री के अनुसार सरकारी आवास अस्वीकार करने पर HRA की पात्रता प्रभावित होती है। इसलिए कारण (R) का यह कथन कि सरकारी आवास अस्वीकार करने से HRA अपात्र हो सकता है, अभिकथन के विपरीत है।

questions.question_english: Review these statements regarding the admissibility of HRA: I. HRA is not admissible if the government servant’s spouse has been allotted government accommodation at the same station. II. HRA can be drawn during Earned Leave up to a maximum period of 180 days. options_hindi: सुश्री गुप्ता सही हैं; जमा अर्जित अवकाश किसी भी प्रशासनिक परिस्थिति में अस्वीकार नहीं किया जा सकता

questions.question_english: Ms. Gupta, a Principal, has a personal emergency. She applies for Earned Leave (EL) for 15 days. The competent authority denies her leave citing ongoing official examinations. She argues that since she has 200 days of EL in her account, she has a right to take it. What is the correct administrative position?
options_english: Ms. Gupta is correct; accumulated EL cannot be denied under any administrative circumstances during official service.
The sanctioning authority may refuse or revoke leave per public service exigencies.
Leave can only be denied by the administrative authority if the employee’s total leave balance is less than 30 days.
She must automatically be granted Half Pay Leave instead of Earned Leave during official board examination duties.
questions.explanation_english: Accumulation of earned leave does not grant an absolute right to take leave. Under Central Civil Services Leave Rules, the competent authority retains administrative discretion to refuse, curtail, or revoke leave whenever public service exigencies require the employee’s physical presence on duty, such as during official examination duties in educational institutions

questions.question_english: Which option below defines ‘Superannuation Pension’?
options_english: Pension granted on retirement upon attaining superannuation age
Pension granted upon seeking voluntary retirement after twenty years of service
Pension granted when an employee is certified as permanently medically invalidated

questions.explanation_english: Superannuation Pension is a statutory pension granted to a government servant who retires from service upon attaining the prescribed age of superannuation. questions.question_english: A male employee, Mr. Kumar, is anticipating the birth of his child. He applies for Paternity Leave 10 days before the expected date of delivery. Is this permissible under the rules?
options_english: No, Paternity Leave can only be applied for and sanctioned strictly after the actual delivery of the child
Yes, up to 15 days before or within 6 months after delivery

No, Paternity Leave is strictly granted as a single day of leave on the exact date of delivery

questions.explanation_english: Under Fundamental Rule 54-B, when a government servant under suspension is honorably acquitted by a court of law, the suspension is considered wholly unjustified. Upon reinstatement, the entire period of suspension is treated as duty for all purposes, with full pay and allowances less subsistence allowance drawn
